outcomes.details: Wanted checklist is not the referenced military instructions. Do not say no administrative command could exist; a records request may be a directive in ordinary usage. Exclude asserted operative military-instruction identity, preserve as evidence lead. Producer misallocates some entries: no second Brown at Sacketts Harbour; officer commanding there. July27 attaches Izard, not Lewis.

Producer Oct16 date rejected. Zoom shows 1815 or16 beneath ca.Oct19,1816; preserve uncertainty. Clause7 is belligerent vessels under whatever flag plus American/other contraband vessels bound to belligerent-country ports, not all foreign-flag merchants. Clause6 includes specie/bullion/passengers. Military exception and final adoption/dispatch hold remain.

On-document presidential attribution and command confirmed, but blank signature/vessel fields and military historical inclusion rule remain. Proposed broad historical unit cannot itself adopt census convention. Producer presidential seal characterization unsupported: visible eagle archival stamp is not independent evidence of presidential seal/authentication.

Presidential attribution/date and substantive mission commands supported. Later-added date/signature and April circulation are derivative editorial evidence; June20 manuscript date visible. Full command inventory includes reporting, safety, return, credit, discharge and succession; producer three-entry inventory too compressed for full scope. Broad proposed definition not adopted rule.

Heading reads Represent to Genl Wilkinson, not Report. Convention source03 date appears Nov8, not producer Nov5; no secure separate prior-Nov5 chronology. Source07 envelope explicitly addressed to President; no outward dispatch inferred. Draft alternatives separate; archival eagle stamps not presidential assent evidence.

First-draft cover is0805, not0806. 0806 is page2;0807 insertion content rather than asserted page3.0795 cover itself explicitly says rough draft refusing communication. Do not search for actual January12 instructions as if such instrument established: actual older instructions referenced by Jan12 message are the lead. No inclusion of cited Conner order.

Producer had not seen022917 pages; reviewer acquired/inspected all8. Explicit Copy and matching complete sequence support same administrative instruction as separate draft/copy witnesses. Strong inclusion recommendation as administrative directive is reasonable only with historical/census crosswalk held; no proof of sent autograph/dispatch or second issuance.

scope: Research proposal/source corrections only. No census admission/status/lifecycle/human certification.
